reviewed: 2026-09-24, rendered pages captured at 390x844 and 1280x900 with Chromium, reviewed by eye
basis: Clean, legible, genuinely mobile-first, WCAG-AA contrast by construction, fast. What holds it at 3 rather than 4: no logo, no photography, and a palette that is tasteful but not distinctive. Brand distinctiveness is an explicit part of this dimension and it cannot be earned without the client's assets.
issues_found_and_fixed: Mobile header consumed about 290px of an 844px viewport before any content — the phone button duplicated the sticky call bar. Header CTA now hidden below 720px; header is roughly 170px.
'Call 207-740-4441' wrapped onto two lines in the sticky bar. Now nowrap with a slightly smaller size and a fixed-width Text button.
Service card headings broke awkwardly across lines in narrow grid columns. Card heading size reduced inside .grid.
not_changed: Desktop layout reviewed at 1280 and left alone — hierarchy, measure and card grid all read correctly.
